✍️🪶 *Goethe & Telc Exam Writing Simulator*

Practice official writing tasks (emails, letters, forum posts) for levels *A1, A2, and B1*.

Stork will evaluate:
• 📊 Exam criteria scoring (out of 100)
• 📏 Word count and completeness of Leitpunkte
• 🔍 Grammar, cases, and word order
• 🌟 Provide a certified model answer (*Musterlösung*)

Select your target level:

placement_welcome:
🎓🪶 *German CEFR Placement Test*

Want to assess your verified German level (*A1, A2, B1*)?

This test includes *12 quick questions*:
• 🌱 4 questions for A1 (basic verbs, articles, prepositions)
• 🌿 4 questions for A2 (Perfekt tense, cases, conjunctions)
• 🌳 4 questions for B1 (Passiv, Konjunktiv II, complex clauses)
